comparison.objective: Seat an ear-thermometer probe, trigger measurement, hold it still, then lay it down; candidate performs terminal extraction.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests compliant anatomical alignment, button pressing, and steady holding. Candidate tests recessed dual-blade insertion, tang force control, and bimanual withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires valid seating, held stillness through the reading/beep, and final placement. Candidate requires selective rearward terminal exit with neighbor retention and no component damage.
comparison.reason: The only shared primitive is careful insertion; the tested mechanisms and outcomes are unrelated.
